title: Task State
description: Global task state for a single /article or /init invocation. Lives at memory/workspace/{task_id}/state.json.

task_id.description: Unique 8-32 char ID (lowercase alphanumeric + underscore), generated by orchestrator

project_slug.description: Active project slug (e.g. 'example-com'). null when running orphan article without project

command.description: Original command that started this task

brief.description: Per-article brief inputs (one of the 3 pillars)

cta_target.description: DEPRECATED v3.34 (2026-07-04): never consumed by any executor. CTA config now lives in business-context.json :: cta, read by scripts/optimize/cta_injector.py.

cta_style.description: DEPRECATED v3.34: never consumed by any executor. See business-context.json :: cta.

quality_target_score.description: Reviewer score target. OMIT unless the operator explicitly wants a stricter bar — nothing applies schema defaults at runtime; the enforced fallback is scripts/_core/review_target.py :: DEFAULT_REVIEW_TARGET (80), and tests pin this annotation to it. The old annotation here said 95 while every gate enforced 80; a brief author copied it and burned six repair rounds (2026-08-17).

local_mode.description: v5.0 Stage C. True when _detect_local_intent.py detected geographic intent in keyword. Seo-blog routing branches to local-* templates when true.

location_anchor.description: v5.0 Stage C. Canonical location detected from keyword. Drives schema-generator's areaServed / spatialCoverage + writer agent's location-specific signal emphasis. Null when local_mode=false.

canonical.description: Canonical short form. US state = 2-letter abbrev (CA, NY, OK); world admin1 = ISO code where common (ON, BC, QLD) else name ('Guangdong'); country = ISO2 ('CA', 'GB'); city = 'Denver' / 'Toronto'; zip = 5-digit; region = 'PNW' / 'DMV' / 'Tri-State'

name_full.description: Full human-readable name e.g. 'Oklahoma', 'Denver, CO', 'Pacific Northwest'

fips.description: US FIPS code (state = 2-digit; county = 5-digit). Null for non-US or non-FIPS locations.

geonameid.description: GeoNames database ID for cross-reference. Null when GeoNames lookup not available.

country.description: ISO2 country code of the anchor (v3.40.0: global detection — CA, GB, AU, CN, … not just US).

containing_state.description: For type=city: the containing state/province code or name. E.g. Denver → 'CO', Toronto → 'ON', Shenzhen → 'Guangdong'.

population.description: Population (for ambiguity resolution — pick highest when names collide).

ambiguous.description: True when multiple matches were possible and no clear winner. When true, disambiguation_options is populated.

disambiguation_options.description: Alternative candidates when ambiguous=true. User picks one to resolve.

cta_category_hint.description: Operator-designated CTA product-category (slug or human name) from the content plan, e.g. a batch row's 'Ear wash' angle resolved to 'ear-eye-skin-care'. Consumed by scripts/optimize/cta_brief_builder.build_brief: preferred over content-based category matching, but STILL subject to conversion_offers.excluded_categories and in-stock validation (a hint can never reach an Rx/forbidden category). Added 2026-08-08 after two batch articles needed hand-edited cta-brief.json overrides because short/one-token category names structurally lose the v3.42.3 core-hit match. Distinct from the DEPRECATED cta_target (v3.34 tombstone, never consumed).

brand_guideline_ref.description: Relative path to context/brand-voice.md or projects/{slug}/brand-voice.md

research_brief_ref.description: Path to auto-generated research-brief.md in workspace

stage_history.description: Audit trail of stage executions. 'in_progress' entries are finalized by record_stage_complete; if they persist with old timestamps, the stage crashed without finalizing (see references/orchestration/stage-tracking.md). 2026-05-22: enum extended to include in_progress so the helper can record stages incrementally.

repair_iteration.description: Current repair round (0 = no repair yet, 5 = exhausted)
